eyebrow: So we all build in the same direction
title: Design
lede: Two layers. Team and recruiting material (this HQ, the builder application) uses the Hopamine visual language. The product itself follows the live site. A visual synopsis and inspiration board is on Mawuli's list.

blocks.title: Hopamine wheel · blue in every colourway

items.title: Type
items.text: Bootzy caps for display (−5.5%), Grotalism Black caps-only (−9%), Glamour for the cursive overlay. **No Google Fonts.** Drop the licensed files in `assets/fonts/`; until then HQ falls back to system faces.

items.title: Product (live site)
items.text: White ground, electric blue #00A6F3, map first, hexagons and the beehive feeling. The globe is the product.

items.title: Accent discipline
items.text: Pink marks the cursive and the stamp dots. Green marks what you can click or count. Nothing else.

do: Map first. The globe is the product.
Show human scale: density, glow, volume of people and projects.
Motion that feels like travelling into a place.
Let the user drive (CLI) and let Zima meet them halfway.
dont: Dense dashboards at first glance (bounce-rate killer).
GeoRemedy-level data on the front of the site.
Feed-style, text-only, channel-by-channel layouts. Discord already does that.
